editorial.blurb: Hannas brings authentic Ethiopian cuisine to Torquay with warmth, passion, and beautifully decorated surroundings that celebrate true culinary tradition.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday for the best experience, and dress warmly as the restaurant is located in the old market space—especially important in winter.
